text: APPROVE: The extraction moves the pattern-resolution logic into `ResolveGoEmbedPattern` unchanged, mapping each `continue` to `return null` and each add to a null-checked `hostEmbeds.Add`, so behaviour is preserved. The nesting and branches removed from `CollectGoEmbedRefs` bring it well under 15, and the new private static helper should build cleanly, assuming `HostEmbedRef` is a reference type (it looks like a record class) and nullable annotations are enabled. I could only judge this from the diff, so I did not run the build or the tests.
